# Alex Rivera

Senior data engineer at Northwind Labs · Porto, Portugal

- 7+ years building data pipelines
- 2 university degrees

## About me

Hi, I'm Alex. I build data platforms that people can trust. I've lived in Porto since
2024, after five years in Lisbon. Before that I lived in Seville and worked in Madrid.
I grew up in Valencia, so I speak Spanish and English, and I'm slowly learning
Portuguese.

I care about boring, reliable pipelines, clear documentation and teams that share
knowledge. Outside work I go bouldering and bake sourdough bread.

Alex has done calisthenics every morning for ten years: it is his longest-running
habit. Python sits at the centre of his toolkit.
